problemStatement.formal: Characterize n for which the Sylow 2-subgroup S2 of (ZMod n)ˣ is (a) cyclic, (b) elementary abelian. S2 ≅ D(a) × prod_{odd p|n} C_{2^{v2(p-1)}} where D(a)=1,C2,C2×C_{2^{a-2}} for v2(n)=a≤1,=2,≥3.
problemStatement.plain: Does the 2-torsion bound extend to characterize when the Sylow 2-subgroup of (ZMod n)ˣ is elementary abelian versus cyclic? Answer: yes — S2 cyclic ⟺ (ZMod n)ˣ cyclic ⟺ n in {1,2,4,p^k,2p^k}; S2 elementary abelian ⟺ every odd prime divisor ≡ 3 (mod 4) and v2(n) ≤ 3.
